verses.original: כָּל־ שִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וַיָּבֹ֜אוּ אֶל־ דָּוִ֖ד חֶבְר֑וֹנָה וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ לֵאמֹ֔ר הִנְנ֛וּ אֲנָֽחְנוּ׃ וּֽבְשָׂרְךָ֖ עַצְמְךָ֥
verses.transliteration: kāl- šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- dā·wiḏ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh way·yō·mə·rū lê·mōr hin·nū ’ă·nā·ḥə·nū ū·ḇə·śā·rə·ḵā ‘aṣ·mə·ḵā
verses.literal: Then all the tribes of Israel came to David at Hebron and said . . . Here we [are] your own flesh and blood

verses.original: גַּם־ אֶתְמ֣וֹל גַּם־ שִׁלְשׁ֗וֹם שָׁא֥וּל בִּהְי֨וֹת מֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עָלֵ֔ינוּ אַתָּ֗ה הָיִיתָה מוֹצִיא יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְהַמֵּבִי אֶת־ לְךָ֗ יְהוָ֜ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר אַתָּ֨ה תִרְעֶ֤ה אֶת־ עַמִּי֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאַתָּ֛ה תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְנָגִ֖יד עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: gam- ’eṯ·mō·wl gam- šil·šō·wm šā·’ūl bih·yō·wṯ me·leḵ ‘ā·lê·nū ’at·tāh hå̄·yī·ṯå̄h mō·ṣī yiś·rā·’êl wə·ham·mē·ḇī ’eṯ- lə·ḵā Yah·weh way·yō·mer ’at·tāh ṯir·‘eh ’eṯ- ‘am·mî ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·’at·tāh tih·yeh lə·nā·ḡîḏ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Even . . . . . . in times past while Saul was king over us you were the one who led Israel out . . . and brought them back - And to you the LORD said You will shepherd - My people - Israel and you will be ruler over [them]

verses.original: כָּל־ זִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל וַ֠יָּבֹאוּ אֶל־ הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ חֶבְר֔וֹנָה בְּחֶבְר֖וֹן הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ דָּוִ֥ד וַיִּכְרֹ֣ת לָהֶם֩ בְּרִ֛ית לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיִּמְשְׁח֧וּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֛ד לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ
verses.transliteration: kāl- ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·ḇō·’ū ’el- ham·me·leḵ ḥeḇ·rō·w·nāh bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn ham·me·leḵ dā·wiḏ way·yiḵ·rōṯ lā·hem bə·rîṯ lip̄·nê Yah·weh way·yim·šə·ḥū ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: So all the elders of Israel came to the king at Hebron [where] King David made with them a covenant before the LORD And they anointed - [him] king over Israel

verses.original: דָּוִ֖ד שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים בֶּן־ שָׁנָ֛ה בְּמָלְכ֑וֹ מָלָֽךְ׃ אַרְבָּעִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ šə·lō·šîm ben- šā·nāh bə·mā·lə·ḵōw mā·lāḵ ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh
verses.literal: David was thirty years old . . . when he became king [and] he reigned forty years

verses.original: בְּחֶבְרוֹן֙ מָלַ֣ךְ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֔ה שֶׁ֥בַע שָׁנִ֖ים וְשִׁשָּׁ֣ה חֳדָשִׁ֑ים וּבִירוּשָׁלִַ֣ם מָלַ֗ךְ שְׁלֹשִׁ֤ים וְשָׁלֹשׁ֙ שָׁנָ֔ה עַ֥ל כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וִיהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥeḇ·rō·wn mā·laḵ ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh še·ḇa‘ šā·nîm wə·šiš·šāh ḥo·ḏā·šîm ū·ḇî·rū·šā·lim mā·laḵ šə·lō·šîm wə·šā·lōš šā·nāh ‘al kāl- yiś·rā·’êl wî·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: In Hebron he reigned over Judah seven years and six months and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty-three . . . years over all Israel and Judah

verses.original: הַמֶּ֤לֶךְ וַֽאֲנָשָׁיו֙ וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֶל־ הַיְבֻסִ֖י יוֹשֵׁ֣ב הָאָ֑רֶץ וַיֹּ֨אמֶר לְדָוִ֤ד לֹא־ תָב֣וֹא הֵ֔נָּה כִּ֣י אִם־ הַעִוְרִ֤ים וְהַפִּסְחִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הֱסִֽירְךָ֗ לֵאמֹר֙ דָוִ֖ד לֹֽא־ יָב֥וֹא הֵֽנָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ham·me·leḵ wa·’ă·nā·šāw way·yê·leḵ yə·rū·šā·lim ’el- hay·ḇu·sî yō·wō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ way·yō·mer lə·ḏā·wiḏ lō- ṯā·ḇō·w hên·nāh kî ’im- ha·‘iw·rîm wə·hap·pis·ḥîm lê·mōr hĕ·sî·rə·ḵā lê·mōr ḏā·wiḏ lō- yā·ḇō·w hên·nāh
verses.literal: Now the king and his men marched to Jerusalem against the Jebusites who inhabited the land The Jebusites said to David You will never get in here Even . . . the blind and lame . . . can repel you For they thought David cannot get in here

verses.original: דָּוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת וַיִּלְכֹּ֣ד מְצֻדַ֣ת צִיּ֑וֹן הִ֖יא עִ֥יר דָּוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ ’êṯ way·yil·kōḏ mə·ṣu·ḏaṯ ṣî·yō·wn hî ‘îr dā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Nevertheless , David captured the fortress of Zion that is the City of David

verses.original: הַה֗וּא כָּל־ בַּיּ֣וֹם דָּוִ֜ד וַיֹּ֨אמֶר מַכֵּ֤ה יְבֻסִי֙ בַּצִּנּ֔וֹר וְאֶת־ וְיִגַּ֣ע הַפִּסְחִים֙ וְאֶת־ הַ֣עִוְרִ֔ים שָׂנְאוּ נֶ֣פֶשׁ דָּוִ֑ד עַל־ כֵּן֙ יֹֽאמְר֔וּ עִוֵּ֣ר וּפִסֵּ֔חַ לֹ֥א יָב֖וֹא אֶל־ הַבָּֽיִת׃
verses.transliteration: ha·hū kāl- bay·yō·wm dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer mak·kêh yə·ḇu·sî baṣ·ṣin·nō·wr wə·’eṯ- wə·yig·ga‘ hap·pis·ḥîm wə·’eṯ- ha·‘iw·rîm śå̄·nə·ʾū ne·p̄eš dā·wiḏ ‘al- kên yō·mə·rū ‘iw·wêr ū·p̄is·sê·aḥ lō yā·ḇō·w ’el- hab·bā·yiṯ
verses.literal: On that . . . day [he] said Whoever attacks the Jebusites must use the water shaft - to reach the lame - and blind who are despised . . . by David That is why . . . it is said The blind and the lame will never enter . . . the palace

verses.original: דָּוִד֙ וַיֵּ֤שֶׁב בַּמְּצֻדָ֔ה וַיִּקְרָא־ לָ֖הּ עִ֣יר דָּוִ֑ד דָּוִד֙ וַיִּ֤בֶן סָבִ֔יב מִן־ הַמִּלּ֖וֹא וָבָֽיְתָה׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yê·šeḇ bam·mə·ṣu·ḏāh way·yiq·rā- lāh ‘îr dā·wiḏ dā·wiḏ way·yi·ḇen sā·ḇîḇ min- ham·mil·lō·w wā·ḇā·yə·ṯāh
verses.literal: So David took up residence in the fortress and called it the City of David He built it up all the way around from the supporting terraces inward

verses.original: דָּוִ֖ד וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ הָל֣וֹךְ וְגָד֑וֹל וַיהוָ֛ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י צְבָא֖וֹת עִמּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yê·leḵ hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḡā·ḏō·wl Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: And David became greater and greater for the LORD God of Hosts was with him

verses.original: חִירָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צֹ֥ר וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח מַלְאָכִים֮ אֶל־ דָּוִד֒ אֲרָזִ֔ים וַעֲצֵ֣י וְחָרָשֵׁ֣י עֵ֔ץ וְחָֽרָשֵׁ֖י אֶ֣בֶן קִ֑יר וַיִּבְנֽוּ־ בַ֖יִת לְדָוִֽד׃
verses.transliteration: ḥî·rām me·leḵ- ṣōr way·yiš·laḥ mal·’ā·ḵîm ’el- dā·wiḏ ’ă·rā·zîm wa·‘ă·ṣê wə·ḥā·rā·šê ‘êṣ wə·ḥā·rā·šê ’e·ḇen qîr way·yiḇ·nū- ḇa·yiṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent envoys to David along with cedar logs carpenters . . . and stonemasons . . . . . . and they built a palace for David

verses.original: דָּוִ֔ד וַיֵּ֣דַע כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֛ה הֱכִינ֧וֹ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְכִי֙ נִשֵּׂ֣א מַמְלַכְתּ֔וֹ בַּעֲב֖וּר עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yê·ḏa‘ kî- Yah·weh hĕ·ḵî·nōw lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḵî niś·śê mam·laḵ·tōw ba·‘ă·ḇūr ‘am·mōw yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: And David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel . . . and had exalted his kingdom for the sake of His people Israel

verses.original: אַחֲרֵ֖י בֹּא֣וֹ מֵחֶבְר֑וֹן דָּוִ֨ד וַיִּקַּח֩ ע֜וֹד פִּֽלַגְשִׁ֤ים וְנָשִׁים֙ מִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם ע֛וֹד בָּנִ֥ים וּבָנֽוֹת׃ וַיִּוָּ֥לְדּוּ לְדָוִ֖ד
verses.transliteration: ’a·ḥă·rê bō·’ōw mê·ḥeḇ·rō·wn dā·wiḏ way·yiq·qaḥ ‘ō·wḏ pi·laḡ·šîm wə·nā·šîm mî·rū·šā·lim ‘ō·wḏ bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ way·yiw·wå̄·lə·dū lə·ḏā·wiḏ
verses.literal: After he had arrived from Hebron David took more concubines and wives from Jerusalem and more sons and daughters were born to him

verses.original: וְאֵ֗לֶּה שְׁמ֛וֹת הַיִּלֹּדִ֥ים ל֖וֹ בִּירוּשָׁלִָ֑ם שַׁמּ֣וּעַ וְשׁוֹבָ֔ב וְנָתָ֖ן וּשְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êl·leh šə·mō·wṯ hay·yil·lō·ḏîm lōw bî·rū·šā·lim šam·mū·a‘ wə·šō·w·ḇāḇ wə·nā·ṯān ū·šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: These are the names of the children born to him in Jerusalem Shammua Shobab Nathan Solomon

verses.original: וְיִבְחָ֥ר וֶאֱלִישׁ֖וּעַ וְנֶ֥פֶג וְיָפִֽיעַ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yiḇ·ḥār we·’ĕ·lî·šū·a‘ wə·ne·p̄eḡ wə·yā·p̄î·a‘
verses.literal: Ibhar Elishua Nepheg Japhia

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁמָ֥ע וְאֶלְיָדָ֖ע וֶאֱלִיפָֽלֶט׃פ
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā·mā‘ wə·’el·yā·ḏā‘ we·’ĕ·lî·p̄ā·leṭ
verses.literal: Elishama Eliada and Eliphelet

verses.original: פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ כִּי־ דָּוִ֤ד מָשְׁח֨וּ אֶת־ לְמֶ֙לֶךְ֙ עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים כָל־ וַיַּעֲל֥וּ לְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֶת־ דָּוִ֑ד דָּוִ֔ד וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע וַיֵּ֖רֶד אֶל־ הַמְּצוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yiš·mə·‘ū kî- dā·wiḏ mā·šə·ḥū ’eṯ- lə·me·leḵ ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl pə·liš·tîm ḵāl way·ya·‘ă·lū lə·ḇaq·qêš ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ dā·wiḏ way·yiš·ma‘ way·yê·reḏ ’el- ham·mə·ṣū·ḏāh
verses.literal: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed - king over Israel they all went in search of - [him] but [David] learned [of this] and went down to the stronghold

verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בָּ֑אוּ וַיִּנָּטְשׁ֖וּ בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm bā·’ū way·yin·nā·ṭə·šū bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: Now the Philistines had come and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim

verses.original: דָּוִ֤ד וַיִּשְׁאַ֨ל בַּֽיהוָה֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הַאֶֽעֱלֶה֙ אֶל־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים הֲתִתְּנֵ֖ם בְּיָדִ֑י עֲלֵ֔ה וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֤ה אֶל־ דָּוִד֙ כִּֽי־ נָתֹ֥ן אֶתֵּ֛ן אֶת־ הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים בְּיָדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yiš·’al Yah·weh lê·mōr ha·’e·‘ĕ·leh ’el- pə·liš·tîm hă·ṯit·tə·nêm bə·yā·ḏî ‘ă·lêh way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- dā·wiḏ kî- nā·ṯōn ’et·tên ’eṯ- hap·pə·liš·tîm bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: So David inquired of the LORD Should I go up against the Philistines Will You deliver them into my hand Go up replied the LORD - - for I will surely deliver . . . - the Philistines into your hand

verses.original: דָוִ֥ד וַיָּבֹ֨א בְּבַֽעַל־ פְּרָצִים֮ וַיַּכֵּ֣ם שָׁ֣ם דָּוִד֒ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר כְּפֶ֣רֶץ מָ֑יִם יְהוָ֧ה אֶת־ פָּרַ֨ץ אֹיְבַ֛י לְפָנַ֖י עַל־ כֵּ֗ן קָרָ֛א שֵֽׁם־ הַה֖וּא בַּ֥עַל הַמָּק֥וֹם פְּרָצִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḏā·wiḏ way·yā·ḇō bə·ḇa·‘al- pə·rā·ṣîm way·yak·kêm šām dā·wiḏ way·yō·mer kə·p̄e·reṣ mā·yim Yah·weh ’eṯ- pā·raṣ ’ō·yə·ḇay lə·p̄ā·nay ‘al- kên qā·rā šêm- ha·hū ba·‘al ham·mā·qō·wm pə·rā·ṣîm
verses.literal: So David went vvv to Baal-perazim where he defeated [the Philistines] . . . . . . and said Like a bursting flood the LORD - has burst out against my enemies before me So . . . he called . . . that vvv place Baal-perazim

verses.original: שָׁ֖ם וַיַּעַזְבוּ־ עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם אֶת־ דָּוִ֖ד וַאֲנָשָֽׁיו׃פ וַיִּשָּׂאֵ֥ם
verses.transliteration: šām way·ya·‘az·ḇū- ‘ă·ṣab·bê·hem ’eṯ- dā·wiḏ wa·’ă·nā·šāw way·yiś·śā·’êm
verses.literal: There the Philistines abandoned their idols - and David and his men carried them away

verses.original: וַיֹּסִ֥פוּ ע֛וֹד פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לַֽעֲל֑וֹת וַיִּנָּֽטְשׁ֖וּ בְּעֵ֥מֶק רְפָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·si·p̄ū ‘ō·wḏ pə·liš·tîm la·‘ă·lō·wṯ way·yin·nā·ṭə·šū bə·‘ê·meq rə·p̄ā·’îm
verses.literal: Once again . . . the Philistines came up and spread out in the Valley of Rephaim

verses.original: דָּוִד֙ וַיִּשְׁאַ֤ל בַּֽיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֣א תַעֲלֶ֑ה הָסֵב֙ אֶל־ אַ֣חֲרֵיהֶ֔ם וּבָ֥אתָ לָהֶ֖ם מִמּ֥וּל בְּכָאִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ way·yiš·’al Yah·weh way·yō·mer lō ṯa·‘ă·leh hā·sêḇ ’el- ’a·ḥă·rê·hem ū·ḇā·ṯā lā·hem mim·mūl bə·ḵā·’îm
verses.literal: So David inquired of the LORD who answered Do not march straight up but circle around behind them and attack them in front of the balsam trees

verses.original: וִ֠יהִי בְּשָׁמְעֲךָ אֶת־ ק֧וֹל צְעָדָ֛ה בְּרָאשֵׁ֥י הַבְּכָאִ֖ים תֶּחֱרָ֑ץ כִּ֣י אָ֗ז אָ֣ז יְהוָה֙ יָצָ֤א לְפָנֶ֔יךָ לְהַכּ֖וֹת בְּמַחֲנֵ֥ה פְלִשְׁתִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wî·hî bə·šå̄·mə·ʿă·ḵå̄ ’eṯ- qō·wl ṣə·‘ā·ḏāh bə·rā·šê hab·bə·ḵā·’îm te·ḥĕ·rāṣ kî ’āz ’āz Yah·weh yā·ṣā lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā lə·hak·kō·wṯ bə·ma·ḥă·nêh p̄ə·liš·tîm
verses.literal: As soon as you hear - the sound of marching in the tops of the balsam trees move quickly because this will mean that . . . the LORD has gone out before you to strike the camp of the Philistines

verses.original: דָּוִד֙ כֵּ֔ן וַיַּ֤עַשׂ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה צִוָּ֖הוּ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֔ים מִגֶּ֖בַע עַד־ בֹּאֲךָ֥ גָֽזֶר׃פ
verses.transliteration: dā·wiḏ kên way·ya·‘aś ka·’ă·šer Yah·weh ṣiw·wā·hū way·yaḵ ’eṯ- pə·liš·tîm mig·ge·ḇa‘ ‘aḏ- bō·’ă·ḵā ḡā·zer
verses.literal: So David . . . did as the LORD had commanded him and he struck down - the Philistines all the way from Gibeon to . . . Gezer
